title: The Old Belief and the New Question

collection.credit:

question.name: The Old Belief and the New Question
question.text: A young Isolan asks an elder whether accepting a new community means forgetting the people who came before.

choices.label: Invite the elder to share the old stories.
Ask the young Isolan to write a reflection.

a1.text: The villagers record the stories respectfully.

a2.text: A forgotten song is revived and taught to the children.

a3.text: A disagreement arises, but careful listening leads to a new understanding.

b2.text: The child writes an unintentionally funny comparison of the two traditions. The adults laugh kindly and discuss it.

b3.text: The child admits that the question remains unanswered, and the elder praises the honesty.
